answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a cipher-bound identity vault before it can trade: the stake unlocks only after the agent completes a series of randomly assigned, verifiable jobs attested by independent peers. Like a lotus opening one petal at a time, reputation and withdrawal rights grow gradually, so a sybil farm must fund thousands of stakes and wait weeks per identity. Detected collusion slashes the whole stake, and the ripple of lost deposits makes mass fakery cost more than the rewards it could harvest.
